title: LaTeX Test Document

author: Dr. Carol White and Prof. David Brown

date: September 2025

This is a LaTeX document for testing pandoc extraction. It includes mathematical equations and special formatting.

Introduction

LaTeX is widely used for academic and scientific documents. This document tests pandoc's ability to extract content and metadata from LaTeX sources.

Mathematical Content

The quadratic formula is given by:

x = (-b +/- sqrt(b^2-4ac)) / 2a

Inline math also works: E = mc^2.

Lists and Formatting

Enumerated List

First item Second item with bold text Third item with italic text

Itemized List

Bullet point one Bullet point two Nested items: Sub-item A Sub-item B

Tables

Left Center Right A1 B1 C1 A2 B2 C2

Sample Table

Conclusion

This document demonstrates LaTeX features for pandoc extraction testing.
